senses.gloss: m. (rufulus) a military tribune chosen by the general himself; (adopted in the Persian bureaucracy) a high official, royal adjutant or viceroy.
units: <cite ref="Shevuot 6b:11">Shebu. 6ᵇ</cite> <he>כגון מלכא ור׳ וכ׳</he> as, for instance, the king is followed by the Rufila, and the Alḳafta by the Resh Galutha.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 49b:4">B. Mets. 49ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Bava Metzia 107b:16">107ᵇ</cite> <he>פרזק ר׳</he>.—Pl. <he>רוֹפִילִין</he>.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Ruth 1:2">Targ. Ruth I, 2</cite> <he>והוו תמן ר׳</he> and they became there military tribunes (h. text <he>ויהיו שם</he>).
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Esther 9:6">Targ. Esth. IX, 6</cite>; <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Esther 9:12">ib. 12</cite> (ed. Vien. <he>רוֹפִלִין</he>).
